commit_scope: Add a bounded unlisted-public Form-grounded dialogue CPU lane with persistent receipts, crash recovery, source disclosure gates, MCP access, expiry, and removal.

local_validation.details: Form source preflight returned zero errors, warnings, and unresolved calls; Go/Rust/TypeScript returned 63; direct fkwu returned 63; 106 focused Docker/config/dialogue/MCP/federation tests and 51 shared grounding/MCP-substrate regression tests passed with Python warnings promoted to errors. The full local PR guard passed 403 selected API tests, the production web build, and the live worktree runtime check; the exact CI-equivalent full API suite passed all 2128 tests with every Python warning promoted to an error after the application-recipe ownership set, nested kernel-core source reader, and final review repairs were healed. Strict spec, evidence, index, maintainability, and git diff gates passed. The kernel submodule's healed form-cli boundary was regenerated into source-bound bootstrap and Darwin carriers; a cache-empty standard lane copied the committed binary without clang, answered the new carrier identity and pong, the form-cli band returned 524287 on all four arms, and the FNRI source, native dispatch, and standalone witnesses passed. The committed source-stamp verifier accepted carrier-id form-cli-carrier-v2, the native carrier reported that its Form program runs on fkwu, and the public dialogue boundary refuses publication of any nonempty rented answer, keeping remote-generated answer bytes at zero. The Windows full-model composition receipt now resolves the nested source checkout and flat image layout through one runtime directory; all six previously misrouted four-way gates passed locally at 255, 1023, 31, 255, 255, and 2097151, with a contract test guarding every executable validate path. The regeneration recipe now reuses the canonical witnessed stamp instead of a drift-prone duplicate source list. Two independent AI review rounds were run after local proof; the second round's one launch blocker and four hardening signals were embodied and re-witnessed. Thirty GitHub AI-review threads were also embodied: accepted dialogue requests execute their real six-field envelope in Form before persistence, federation offers/reads receive operation-specific encoded shapes in Form, idempotent retry repairs atomically published message indexes, potentially blocking HTTP/MCP Form admission runs in worker threads after known capacity and pacing refusals are screened, federation index read-modify-replace operations are serialized across API processes, running-dialogue release/reaping executes outside both async request loops, the federation recipe resolves from the application package in both source and deployed image layouts, the capacity/rate gate remains atomically held through Form admission and row persistence, and Uvicorn trusts forwarded caller identity only from the observed internal Docker proxy range. Later review rounds moved same-process admission into a nonblocking pre-session slot and PostgreSQL admission onto pg_try_advisory_xact_lock, moved both HTTP and MCP polling into worker threads, installed the Linux process inspector used by ownership-safe reaping, added ownership-safe Windows task-tree termination, moved proxy and federation-store settings onto the shared file-backed configuration precedence, kept the container listener aligned with its fixed expose, healthcheck, and proxy port at 8000, retained the non-public removal-capability hash so identical retries succeed while different capabilities remain rejected, preserved explicit zero MCP timeouts so the shared 10-second floor refuses them before admission, replaced MCP timeout coercion with real-integer admission so nonfinite and noninteger values return structured errors, and made shutdown join and clear its worker before a same-process restart can create the next worker. The final review repairs pass the actual six encoded values through Form, let Form return independently verified content-addressed message and edge identities, persist only those opaque Form identities in Python, contain dialogue storage failures inside sanitized per-tool MCP results so a failed batch member cannot abort its siblings, fsync each graph carrier's parent directory after atomic replacement before acknowledging persistence, serialize native federation kernel invocations through a one-run CPU lane, and stage Form source in a temporary file instead of the operating-system argument vector. A persistent 150,000-byte offer witness crosses that file-backed path through real fkwu and returns valid Form identities. The staged runner now resolves both the nested source stdlib and the production image's flattened /app/form/form-stdlib layout; a simulated image witness verifies that both core and offered recipe reach the carrier. The bridge selects POSIX and Windows shell carriers only through the shared file-backed configuration precedence and fixed defaults; PATH and Program Files environment variables are not configuration authorities. Every staged Form run now starts in an isolated process group, kills and reaps the entire POSIX or Windows process tree on timeout, normalizes timeouts into RuntimeError, and normalizes operating-system launch failures while deleting the staged source. Public callers therefore receive the documented bounded failure instead of an unhandled 500. Every declared MCP dialogue string is validated in its original JSON type before Form admission, storage, lookup, or release; objects, arrays, numbers, and booleans now return field-specific structured errors rather than becoming plausible text. Native federation offers and their SQL projections now run outside the async event loop; the concurrency witness held Form open while another public request completed. The proxy witnesses preserve two public peers through one Traefik/kernel-router carrier while refusing a forged forwarded identity from an untrusted peer. The concurrency witnesses held dialogue admission, polling, release, and native federation identity construction open while public information surfaces remained responsive, refused a second admission before another session or Form process opened, and preserved both IDs in a deliberately widened two-process federation race on five consecutive runs. The broad re-witness also exposed and healed a pre-existing import-order seam by registering verification hash-chain models before unified schema creation; its formerly failing fresh-database request passed alone and within the 2128-test body. The full smoke carrier now selects Uvicorn's maintained websockets-sansio adapter explicitly, healing both third-party deprecation signals; direct native acceptance/refusal calls and all warning-strict suites passed afterward.

post_review_rewitness.details: The exact-head GitHub AI review extended the embodied review set to thirty-two threads and surfaced two further concurrency/idempotency seams. Federation HTTP calls that can enter the native Form CPU lane now wait on a dedicated one-token AnyIO limiter before a worker thread starts, so queued federation requests cannot occupy the shared worker pool used by dialogue admission, polling, and release. A 45-request concurrency witness observed exactly one native offer start while a dialogue poll completed through the shared pool, then all offers completed after release. Authenticated retries of an already tombstoned dialogue now return success without rewriting updated_at, tombstoned_at, or the durable release receipt. The broadened Docker/config/dialogue/MCP/federation band passed 107 tests, and the full CI-equivalent API body passed all 2129 tests in 257.88 seconds with every Python warning promoted to an error.

content_bound_form_rewitness.details: The next exact-head GitHub AI review extended the embodied review set to thirty-three threads and identified that dialogue admission still reduced the six offered values to lengths. Each locale, point of view, question, disclosure acknowledgement, and parent identity is now encoded as its exact UTF-8 hex value and staged into the Form invocation with the numeric timeout. Form validates the encoded envelope, constructs a SHA-256 content receipt over a length-framed six-field wire value, and returns that receipt; Python independently computes the same digest and refuses any valid-looking receipt that is not bound to the offered content. Same-length en/river/hello and fr/ocean/world offers produced different staged Form programs and independently matching receipts. Form preflight reported balanced parentheses with zero errors, warnings, and unresolved calls; Go, Rust, and TypeScript returned 63, and direct fkwu returned 63. The broadened Docker/config/dialogue/MCP/federation band passed 109 tests, and the full CI-equivalent API body passed all 2131 tests in 228.31 seconds with every Python warning promoted to an error.

windows_dialogue_carrier_rewitness.details: The following exact-head GitHub AI review extended the embodied review set to thirty-four threads and found that Windows dialogue retrieval still launched the Bash form-cli wrapper directly through CreateProcess. On Windows, grounded ask now prefixes the wrapper command with the same Git Bash executable selected through shared file-backed Form runtime configuration; POSIX keeps direct wrapper execution. The isolated process launcher and on-process-start callback are unchanged, so the recorded PID continues to identify the Bash process group whose native descendants are reaped together. A simulated supported-Windows witness observed configured bash.exe, bin/form-cli, ask-file, and the staged query path in that order, preserved the PID callback, and returned the native protocol answer. The warning-strict grounding/MCP-substrate band passed 52 tests, and the full CI-equivalent API body passed all 2132 tests in 255.35 seconds with every Python warning promoted to an error.

windows_grounding_receipt_rewitness.details: The exact-head Windows composition run reached the native grounded ask and exposed a CRLF transport seam: Windows Python emitted the authenticated trace receipt with CRLF, Bash removed LF while retaining CR, and the Form trust gate correctly rejected the altered final HMAC field. The wrapper now removes only that terminal transport CR before restaging the receipt; the authenticated payload remains otherwise byte-for-byte unchanged. A direct CRLF witness returned alpha|omega without the carrier CR, the wrapper source/manifest fail-closed contract passed, and all 45 native grounding runtime tests passed. The repaired exact-head Windows Host Floor run 31866879315 then completed successfully, including its Form-native four-way floor, field-relay and FNRI witnesses, Windows fkwu JIT/native form-cli runtime, and full model-inference composition receipt.

whole_body_healing_rewitness.details: Warning-strict full-body observation surfaced three previously latent lifecycle seams and each was repaired before release. The JSON heartbeat relay now preserves one pending receive across keepalive boundaries, arms the next receive before acknowledging the current envelope, retrieves or cancels that task on exit, converts a recipient disconnect during delivery into the defined queue outcome, and prevents an old connection's cleanup from marking a newer socket offline. A heartbeat-boundary regression completes in 0.05 seconds instead of losing or delaying the offered envelope. Pytest's active configuration now gives all asyncio-only tests and fixtures one function-scoped event-loop owner, and the learning-dashboard tests await their async routers inside that lifecycle instead of nesting asyncio.run loops. Forced garbage collection passed the targeted 5-test plugin-transition band, the 16-test economics/exchange band, and the 21-test modality/dashboard neighborhood; the 405-test core passed. After the final relay cleanup and disconnect-race repair, the exact CI-equivalent full API body passed all 2133 tests in 193.98 seconds with every Python warning promoted to an error.

expiry_read_boundary_rewitness.details: The exact-head GitHub AI review extended the embodied review set to thirty-five threads and found that a terminal dialogue could cross expires_at while the single CPU worker attended another carrier, leaving public content readable until the next background sweep. Every dialogue read now locks its row, observes the current time after lock acquisition, and atomically tombstones any row at or beyond its expiry boundary before constructing a public view. The tombstone redacts the question, question digest, point of view, and output in the same transaction; repeated reads preserve the first tombstone timestamp. The exact-boundary SQLite witness and the complete warning-strict public-dialogue band passed all 47 tests; the 405-test core passed. The first full-body pass surfaced a cold Rust live-DB trial build that had hidden its diagnostics; a direct visible cargo build succeeded, its 3-test trial passed, and the complete warning-strict full API body then passed all 2133 tests in 215.60 seconds. Ruff passed both touched Python files, evidence validation passed, and git diff validation passed.
